the quantum trajectory distribution of a superconductingly coupled qubit is well described by a white-noise stochastic model with one free parameter, which is related to the strength of the coupling between qubit and measurement apparatus.

we have experimentally observed the full quantum trajectory distribution for a weak measurement of a superconductingly coupled qubit, and that this quantum trajectory distribution agrees with the predictions of stochastic Schrodinger equation.

the quantum trajectory distribution of weak measurements of a qubit in circuit quantum electrodynamics (circuit QED) architecture is in good agreement with theoretical predictions of a single parameter white-noise stochastic model.
